observations: Photo 0: silver front-loading washing machine on a tiled floor beside a wall, power cable plugged in.

Photo 0: control panel reads 'LG' and 'INVERTER DirectDrive 6/3kg'; red sticker on the front reads 'Washer+Dryer 2 in 1'; a 'Direct Drive 10 year warranty' sticker on the right; exact model code is too small to read.
Photo 0: the programme dial ring is lit orange and the digital display shows digits, so the machine powers on.
Photo 0: programme list includes Dry Only and Wash+Dry, and a separate Dry dial on the right, consistent with a washer dryer.
Photo 0: visible wear: the 2 in 1 sticker is peeling and torn, scuffs and marks on the door trim and lower panel, dirt around the base; clothes are inside the drum.
Only one photo; no clip of a wash, spin or dry cycle, no receipt or warranty card shown.

identity.kind: front load washer dryer 2 in 1, 6kg wash / 3kg dry
identity.model: Inverter DirectDrive 6/3kg washer dryer (exact model code not legible)

claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows the LG logo and 'INVERTER DirectDrive 6/3kg' on the panel; it is a washer dryer.

claims.claim: Scrap, doesn't work and needs repair
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows it powers on (lit dial and display), but no clip shows whether it washes, spins or dries; it is priced as not working, as the seller says.
Photo 0 shows a peeling, torn front sticker, scuffs on the door trim and lower panel and dirt at the base, signs of long use.
No receipt shown; the wear in photo 0 does not fit a machine bought new last year.
The seller's own words say it doesn't work and needs repair; no running clip.
The motor is behind the back panel and cannot be seen; tamper evidence would need the back panel screws photographed.
Neither is shown in the photos.

risks.risk: Machine does not wash, spin or dry (seller says it needs repair); fault could be control board, motor or pump.
risks.proof: Clip of a full short cycle: fill, drum rotation, drain, spin, and the dry function heating.
risks.if_unproven: as not working, scrap or repair unit

risks.risk: Error code on the display pointing to a serious fault.
risks.proof: Close photo of the display after starting a cycle, showing any error code.

risks.risk: Drum bearings, door gasket or door lock damaged.
risks.proof: Photo with the door open showing the gasket folded back and a clip of the drum turned by hand.
risks.if_unproven: as needing bearing and gasket repair

risks.risk: Parts removed or motor tampered with inside.
risks.proof: Photos of the back panel with screws and of the rating plate.

risks.risk: Age and model uncertain; claimed recent purchase not proven.
risks.proof: Photo of the receipt and warranty card matching the serial on the rating plate.
risks.if_unproven: as an old unit of the earliest model in this range

proof_requests: Clip of the machine running a short wash and spin cycle with the display visible, showing any error code.
Close photo of the rating plate with model and serial.
Photo of the receipt and warranty card next to the rating plate.
Photos of the back panel and the open door with the gasket folded back.
response.reason: Photo 0 reads an LG Inverter DirectDrive 6/3kg washer dryer, so it can be priced; the seller's words contradict each other and the wear contradicts 'barely used', so it is priced at the worst case the seller states: not working, for repair or scrap.
